description: Positions sitting at an unrealized loss in a pasted positions export, largest loss first, with the total; given a transactions export too, flags any bought in the last 30 days (wash-sale risk on a sale). Example questions: "What can I tax-loss harvest?"; "Which of my positions are losers?"; "Any losses to offset my gains this year?"

positions_csv.description: The positions/portfolio CSV from the broker, pasted as text (symbol, quantity, market value or last price; a gain or cost-basis column for gains and losses)

transactions_csv.description: The transactions or gains/losses CSV from the broker, pasted as text (E*TRADE download, this repo's CSV, or plain columns date, action, symbol, quantity, price, fee). Optional: flags recent buys for the 30-day rule

title: Tax-Loss Harvest Candidates
